name: Mok'thardin's Enchantment
summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Far Seer Mok'thardin seeks the last sacred water for a ceremonial choker. He sends you to a Holy Spring on the southern bluffs near the western sea, where naga explorers have arrived.

sections.title: A Contested Spring
sections.body: Far Seer Mok'thardin needs water from a Holy Spring high above Stranglethorn Vale's southern bluffs, near the western coast. You have helped with the earlier stages of the enchantment. Scholars of the mystic and divine dispute who the spring was sanctified for. Every race across Azeroth claims its holy waters were meant for its own people.

sections.title: The Naga Incursion
sections.body: Naga explorers have reached the spring, and Mok'thardin needs you to drive them away. Bring him a draught of the water and slay ten of the serpent intruders. He needs both to finish the ceremonial choker in the Warchief's name.

faq.q: Where is the Holy Spring located?
faq.answer: The Holy Spring sits high on the bluffs near the western coast, in southern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why is the Holy Spring considered important?
faq.answer: Scholars of the mystic and divine dispute the spring's importance. Every race across Azeroth claims its divine waters were sanctified for its own people.

faq.q: Who is contesting the Holy Spring?
faq.answer: An expedition of naga explorers has reached the bluffs around the Holy Spring and menaces the area.

faq.q: What is the water being used for?
faq.answer: Far Seer Mok'thardin needs the water as the final reagent to prepare and enchant a ceremonial choker in defense of the Horde.

angles.text: As a Horde champion, you can help Far Seer Mok'thardin finish a ceremonial choker to honor the Warchief and protect the Horde.
